vetSays.line: ⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader White Noise (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader White Noise falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader White Noise!
🛡️ Vanessa, Sanjay, Aaliyah, Joaquín and Gugu met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Sanjay, Aaliyah, Joaquín, Gugu are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Caleb just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Gugu, Fatima, Caleb, Liam and Theo met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Gugu, Fatima, Liam, Theo are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Theo just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Theo just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nino just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sanjay, Gugu, Fatima, Caleb and Nino met them at the door — 5 put down. Gugu, Fatima, Caleb, Nino are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Fatima harries the Scarred Ad Break.
Liam strikes the Scarred Ad Break.
Caleb strikes the Scarred Ad Break.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Stan just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mia just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ava just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
🛡️ Oumaima and Mia met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Oumaima, Mia are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Farid taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

Oumaima has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: Farid passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
🛡️ Oumaima, Hassan and Farid met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Oumaima, Hassan, Farid are hurt.
SYSTEM: "That was... a lot. The producers say the ratings were historic. I don’t know what to do with that sentence."
🛡️ Hassan, Farid and Devon met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Hassan, Farid, Devon are hurt.

📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.

Brian was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
